laws.rule: Cordillera del Yvytyruzu Managed Resources Reserve: MADES lists camping as allowed but no official public visiting hours. Much of the reserve encompasses private properties; obtain the relevant site or landholder access permission rather than treating reserve status as a right of entry. This is not a universal camping permit for all private plots.

sources.title: Cordillera del Yvytyruzu Managed Resources Reserve official visitor conditions and location
sources.supports: Read directly: named department, access conditions, visiting hours where published, and camping allowed or prohibited.

local-law.note: Named protected site only. National public-use rules apply from the country record. Other departmental and municipal levels not yet checked; no admission amount reproduced.
